environment.description: Apollo GraphQL service deployed in private subnet (10.128.0.0/20) behind internal NLB. NLB target group health check on /health. Upstream connectivity governed by VPC endpoint policy attached to com.amazonaws.us-east-1.execute-api interface endpoint. Security group sg-0a3f8e91c (attached to NLB ENIs) has inbound rules restricted to three CIDR prefixes: 10.2.0.0/16 (corporate VPN egress), 10.128.64.0/22 (CI/CD runner subnet), and 172.16.0.0/20 (partner mesh via Transit Gateway peering with route table rtb-0ef912a propagating only those prefixes). No internet gateway or NAT gateway attached to the private subnet. VPC flow logs confirm zero traffic from public IP ranges in last 90 days. The RSA public key at /app/keys/rsa_public.pem is the same key but is not exposed via any public endpoint or certificate transparency log.
